note: 2026-10-22 DAILY BATCH, committed under the chairman's hand before any seat was convened. ONE QUESTION, ONE DOCKET, AND IT IS THE TEST YESTERDAY'S CLOSE-OUT SET AT ITS 6.5 ITEM 1. WHAT YESTERDAY LEFT OPEN, AND IT IS A DEFECT IN AN ABSENCE CLAIM RATHER THAN A GAP IN A FACT. Yesterday's batch walked the '(a) Original Proceeding / Published Decisions' document list to its end and closed the docket chronology to its last entry: row 4's window ran '... Expert Report of Mr. Robert Hobbes Cumulative Index of supporting documentation Combined Hearing Transcripts Available on the ICSID Website' and then into the dated-document section, and row 5's window ran from 'March 14, 2025 ... Procedural Order No. 12' through 'December 16, 2025 Each party files a reply statement of costs.' to 'Footer menu'. But objection 1021-C10 sustained a defect that those rows did not cure: the claim that the LIST names no 'Procedural Order No. 11' and no 'No. 12' rests on a COMPOSITE of eight page states observed 2026-08-13 through 2026-08-20 plus two from 2026-10-20/21, not on any single page state. On the one state observed yesterday (sha256 770d97f5..., 105,769 bytes, run 39596692378) the five windows leave TWO stretches of the list unobserved, and an entry for No. 11 or No. 12 inserted in either of them would be invisible to every row this council has fired. THE TWO HOLES, located from yesterday's own windows rather than from memory. HOLE A sits between the right edge of the 'Status of Proceeding' window, which ends '... Published Decisions Witness Statement of Theodore David Einarsson (Public Version) Procedural Order Statement of Defence Confidentiality Order Witness Statement ', and the left edge of the 'Procedural Order No. 10' window, which begins 'r No. 5 Procedural Order No. 6 ...'. On the August composite the text in that stretch reads '... Counter-Memorial on Jurisdiction, Merits and Damages Procedural Order No. 2 Procedural Order No. 2 - Annex A Procedural Order No. 2 - Annex B Procedural Order No. 3 Procedural Order No. 3 - Annex A Procedural Order No. 4 Procedural Order No. 5 ...' -- i.e. the hole contains the numbered run's own opening, which is exactly where an inserted entry would sit. HOLE B sits between that same window's right edge, which ends 'CWS-09, Witnes', and the left edge of the 'Expert Report of Mr. Robert Hobbes' window, which begins 'Canada's Rejoinder on the Merits Expert Report of Mr. Doug Uffen ...'; on the August composite it holds the CWS-09 through CWS-12 witness statements. Hole B is the shorter of the two and one row reaches across it. WHAT THIS BATCH ASKS. (A) Does the list, read on ONE page state, name any procedural order beyond No. 10 -- specifically, is there an entry for No. 11 or No. 12 anywhere in hole A? (B) Does hole B read as the August composite holds it, so that the list's coverage on a single state becomes continuous from its first entry to its last? (C) Is 'Procedural Order No. 11' still absent from the list region, re-tested on today's state rather than left resting on the 2026-10-19 state where it was last fired? ORDERING PROPERTY THIS BATCH RELIES ON, DERIVED FROM HELD ROWS RATHER THAN ASSUMED: excerpt_of searches VISIBLE PROSE ONLY and returns the FIRST occurrence (scripts/fetch_relay.py:126-135), with the anchor at offset 100 of a 400-character window (EXCERPT_CHARS = 400, start = idx - EXCERPT_CHARS // 4), so every row below returns about 100 characters to the left of its anchor and about 300 to the right. The finds 'Procedural Order No. 4' (2026-08-19) and 'Procedural Order No. 5' (2026-08-18) BOTH returned list text, while 'Procedural Order No. 11' (2026-10-19) returned CHRONOLOGY text: the list region therefore precedes the chronology region in this page's visible prose, and a numbered find returns chronology text only when the list does not name that number. That is what makes rows 2, 4 and 6 interpretable, and it is the same property yesterday's batch derived and yesterday's vetting certified. PRIOR ART, screened on the unquote(url) predicate adopted by objection 0826-C6, measured today over all 716 rows in 95 result files: this URL carries 46 rows across 17 result-file dates and 18 distinct sha256 page states, last observed 2026-10-21 (run 39596692378). PER-FIND COUNTS, measured corpus-wide in the same screen rather than restated: 'Status of Proceeding' 72 fired / 72 TRUE (15 / 15 on this URL); 'Procedural Order No. 11' 1 fired / 1 TRUE (1 / 1 on this URL, 2026-10-19, chronology text); 'Confidentiality Order' 0 fired; 'Counter-Memorial on Jurisdiction, Merits and Damages' 0 fired; 'Procedural Order No. 2' 0 fired; 'CWS-09' 0 fired. Five of six rows below are therefore first firings of their literal anywhere in this corpus. SIX ROWS, ONE URL, within MAX_URLS = 12 (scripts/fetch_relay.py:76). This is a one-day re-observation justified by questions (A), (B) and (C) -- a named defect in a live absence claim -- and not by any cadence. The control https://example.com/ is prepended by the relay itself and is not written below; if it fails the batch is VOID and no row may be read as information about this docket. Host icsid.worldbank.org is on ALLOWED_HOSTS (scripts/fetch_relay.py:48). The UNENCODED 'CaseNo=' form is used: certified 200 by every unencoded row on this URL. COMPANION CONTROLS: rows 2 through 6 may null, and their companion control is ROW 1 ON THE SAME URL IN THE SAME RUN, as analytics/fetch-requests/README.md requires -- a missed find returns the empty string rather than a head excerpt (:132-133), so a null row hands back no window and is uninterpretable alone. DIFF ON THE PROSE, NEVER ON sha256 OR bytes: this URL holds 18 distinct sha256 values across 17 dates on a page whose watched span changed once in that time. A DIFFERING DIGEST OR BYTE COUNT IS NOT MOVEMENT and may never be written as movement. A SINGLE-STATE REQUIREMENT APPLIES TO THE ANSWER: rows 1 through 6 close holes A and B only if they return the SAME sha256, and if the page changes mid-run the continuity claim fails and must be reported as failed rather than stitched. WHAT THIS BATCH MAY NEVER BE WRITTEN UP AS: a disposition, a holding, a ground, or any statement about what any tribunal decided. G16 bars a docket-summary surface from founding a disposition; G10 bars reading a document DESIGNATION as a tribunal's characterisation. A list entry's presence supports ONLY that a document so titled is named as published; its contents remain wholly unread by this council. An ABSENCE in the list supports ONLY that the list does not name such an entry in the retrieved window -- never that no such procedural order issued, and never that it is unpublished. If rows 2 through 5 do establish continuous single-state coverage, the strongest claim that becomes available is still only: on the page state observed on this date, the list does not name a procedural order beyond No. 10. RING STATUS, STATED SO NO SUCCESSOR INFLATES IT: on this council's own held reduction the covered investment on UNCT/20/6 is recorded as a 'Seismic data enterprise' under NAFTA. THAT IS A DATA-ASSET DESIGNATION ON A DOCKET-SUMMARY FIELD AND IT IS NOT AN ESTABLISHED RING-1 PLEADING -- no patent, trademark, GI, trade secret or clinical-trial data is pleaded as the covered investment on any body this council has retrieved, and nothing in this batch can establish one. This docket is worked as an instrument-discipline exercise and as a live docket under watch, not as a theme hit. OUTCOME CLASSES THAT ARE FACTS ABOUT THE INSTRUMENT AND MAY NEVER BE WRITTEN AS FINDINGS ABOUT ICSID OR ABOUT THIS MATTER: control_ok false (whole batch VOID); refused / 403 / 202 / timeout / no_contact; host_not_allowed / scheme_not_https; and a 404 OR A REDIRECT, which is never a statement that a case does not exist -- it would mean only that this designator does not resolve on this surface at this instant, and the project's absence rule is 'not found in accessible sources'. CADENCE AND SCOPE: this batch touches and re-anchors NOTHING ELSE. It is NOT thread 11's search limb (due on or around 2026-10-25, deliberately not pulled forward); it is NOT thread 11's relay row into the Decisions on Manifest Lack of Legal Merit register; it is NOT locked-set row 1-02's forum row; it is NOT the monthly watch on threads 10 or 25; it does NOT touch ARB/22/2 (monthly, next due 2026-11-18), ARB/17/19 or ARB/12/1.
